text: {"claims":[{"cid":"c1","text":"Product-based companies develop and sell their own products.","cited_pids":["c2da60b9dbc2#1","34ae5a565861#7"]},{"cid":"c2","text":"Product-based companies earn revenue through one-time sales, licenses, or subscriptions.","cited_pids":["c2da60b9dbc2#1","34ae5a565861#7"]},{"cid":"c3","text":"The offerings of product-based companies are typically tangible goods such as smartphones or clothing.","cited_pids":["34ae5a565861#6"]},{"cid":"c4","text":"Service-based companies provide services to clients, such as consulting or landscaping.","cited_pids":["34ae5a565861#6","c6670bb8753e#8"]},{"cid":"c5","text":"The offerings of service-based companies are intangible.","cited_pids":["34ae5a565861#6","c6670bb8753e#8"]},{"cid":"c6","text":"Service-based companies earn revenue from client projects and service or recurring contracts.","cited_pids":["c2da60b9dbc2#1","34ae5a565861#8"]},{"cid":"c7","text":"Service-based companies often build long-term client relationships.","cited_pids":["34ae5a565861#8"]},{"cid":"c8","text":"Product-based companies can scale without adding proportional staff.","cited_pids":["5b089398ac4d#6"]},{"cid":"c9","text":"Service-based companies scale with headcount.","cited_pids":["5b089398ac4d#6"]}]}
